title: RPS Mind Reader · Adaptive AI Opponent
description: *RPS Mind Reader* is a **rock-paper-scissors web game** where an AI learns your habits and tries to beat you — the more you play, the better it reads you, so the only way to win consistently is to stay genuinely unpredictable.

Built **100% by an AI coding agent** under my direction. Rather than a heavy neural network, the opponent is a custom **Bayesian mixture of variable-order context models**: each forecasts your next-move *distribution* and votes for the **expected-value-optimal** counter, weighted by how well it has predicted you lately. See [ADR 0010](https://github.com/guplem/guplem.github.io/blob/main/adr/0010-custom-statistical-predictor-no-ml-library.md) for the algorithm choice.
